test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence which has no spelling error.

options.text: He incorporates daily vocablary in his gestures.
She has her own vockbulary words from English and Hindi.
Vocabulary raises the standard of the English language.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Vocabulary raises the standard of the English language." **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **"He incorporates daily vocablary in his gestures"** the incorrect spelling is** vocablary.**
 
• In **"****Reading stories developed her vocabluary"** the incorrect spelling is** vocabluary.**
 
• In **"****She has her own vockbulary words from English and Hindi"** the incorrect spelling is **vockbulary.**
 
• The correct spelling is **Vocabulary. **
 
• **Vocabulary:** All the words that a specific person is familiar with and uses.
 
 
• **Example:** *Reading increases your vocabulary.*
